name: BMW Industries Ltd
title: BMW Industries Ltd - 542669 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Legacy tube/CRM conversion runs at ~34% utilisation with no new capex; Bokaro greenfield (~INR803 crore) starts phased commissioning Q1 FY27, with management guiding ~75% revenue CAGR FY25–FY28 and blended EBITDA margin 12–13%.

utilisation.quote: we are still at about 34.2%. Now we expect stable state tubes and pipes utilization to be in the range of about 60% to 65%

capex.peers_comment: Mentioned Manaksia Color Coated as a listed peer with 5-9% EBITDA margins, but no comment on its capacity.
capex.quote: we are looking at starting saleable production of the color coated section in this quarter
